# bitbucket-datacenter-api-client

> TypeScript client for the [Bitbucket Data Center REST API v10.3](https://developer.atlassian.com/server/bitbucket/rest/v1003/) (`/rest/api/latest`). Isomorphic (Node.js + browser), fully typed, zero runtime dependencies.

Install with `npm install bitbucket-datacenter-api-client`. The entry point is the `BitbucketClient` class; its chainable resources (`project()`, `repo()`, `pullRequest()`, `commit()`, `user()`) implement `PromiseLike`, so each one can be **awaited directly** to fetch that entity, or **chained** to reach a sub-resource (e.g. `bb.project('PROJ').repo('my-repo').pullRequest(42).activities()`).

## Docs

- [README.md](README.md): installation, quick start, usage examples for every resource, pagination (manual paging and the `paginate()` auto-pagination helper), error handling (`BitbucketApiError`), authentication (Basic and Bearer), rate-limit retry (`retry` option), request events, migration notes, and the full list of exported TypeScript types.
- [ROADMAP.md](ROADMAP.md): the complete endpoint coverage matrix — every method mapped to its Bitbucket REST endpoint, with implemented (✅) vs pending (⬜) status, plus the explicit out-of-scope API groups.
- [llms-full.txt](llms-full.txt): this same API reference, fully inlined in a single file — use it when you can't follow links to `README.md`/`ROADMAP.md`.

## Optional

- [CHANGELOG.md](CHANGELOG.md): release history (generated by semantic-release from conventional commits).
- [Published API reference](https://eljijuna.github.io/BitbucketDataCenterApiClient): TypeDoc-generated per-symbol documentation.
